program: EuroHPC JU AI Factories, AI for Industrial Innovation: Fast Lane Access (EuroHPC AI Factory Fast Lane call EHPC-AIF-2026FL) on LUMI-G via LUMI AI Factory
next_step_program: Pay-per-use commercial LUMI access via CSC (LUMI AI Factory commercial access, LUMI service price list)
stopper_list: Free Industrial Innovation access (incl. Fast Lane) is only for AI SMEs/startups under the EU SME definition, group staff/turnover counted; large companies get pay-per-use access (https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/ai-factories/ai-factories-access-modes_en ; https://lumi-supercomputer.eu/access-calls-for-ai-factories/ ; https://lumi-ai-factory.eu/pricing-and-eligibility/ ; https://single-market-economy.ec.europa.eu/smes/sme-fundamentals/sme-definition_en)

Organisation established in an EU Member State or H2020-associated country, for LUMI (https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/document/download/bd7aa666-bdf3-4436-b5ec-0b34a781e817_en?filename=Terms%20of%20Reference%20-%20AIF%20Access%20Calls.pdf section 2a)

PI has an employment contract with the applicant at submission and for at least 3 months after the allocation ends, and is affiliated with the industry applicant (ToR section 2c-d, https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/document/download/bd7aa666-bdf3-4436-b5ec-0b34a781e817_en?filename=Terms%20of%20Reference%20-%20AIF%20Access%20Calls.pdf)

Organisation status proven with a valid VAT number and a PIC if applicable (ToR section 2, https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/document/download/bd7aa666-bdf3-4436-b5ec-0b34a781e817_en?filename=Terms%20of%20Reference%20-%20AIF%20Access%20Calls.pdf)

Civilian purpose only, AI Act compliance, eligibility and ethics self-assessment (ToR sections 2 and 5.1.1, https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/document/download/bd7aa666-bdf3-4436-b5ec-0b34a781e817_en?filename=Terms%20of%20Reference%20-%20AIF%20Access%20Calls.pdf)

No double award: one Fast Lane allocation per PI at a time; proposals with running resources are rejected (ToR sections 1.2 and 2, https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/document/download/bd7aa666-bdf3-4436-b5ec-0b34a781e817_en?filename=Terms%20of%20Reference%20-%20AIF%20Access%20Calls.pdf)

Technical feasibility data mandatory at submission; AI Factory technical assessment; code must run on LUMI-G AMD MI250X/ROCm, otherwise administrative rejection (ToR sections 5.1.1 and 6d, https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/document/download/bd7aa666-bdf3-4436-b5ec-0b34a781e817_en?filename=Terms%20of%20Reference%20-%20AIF%20Access%20Calls.pdf)

LUMI-G Fast Lane request: min 10,000, max 50,000 GPU-hours, 1-3 months, single system; one GPU-hour = one MI250X module (2 GCDs), node-hour = 4 GPU-hours (https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/fast-lane-access-ai-factories_en systems table ; https://docs.lumi-supercomputer.eu/runjobs/lumi_env/billing/)
First come, first served until call resources are exhausted; partitions may be unavailable due to demand (https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/fast-lane-access-ai-factories_en ; ToR section 5.1.1)

Portal call EHPC-AIF-2026FL closes 31 Dec 2026 22:59 UTC; the access-mode page's Apply Now links to the closed 2025 call /calls/49 (https://access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/calls/59 ; https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/ai-factories/ai-factories-access-modes/fast-lane-access-ai-factories_en)
Professional organisation email addresses; consistent PI contact details (ToR section 4 ; https://lumi-supercomputer.eu/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/LUMI-General-Terms-of-Use_2026.pdf)
Resources for R&D only; 24/7 or commercial deployment must run elsewhere (https://lumi-ai-factory.eu/pricing-and-eligibility/)

Post-award duties: publish results except confidential parts, acknowledge EuroHPC/AI Factory, final report within 3 months, EuroHPC may publish it after 1 year, dissemination events; no extensions or extra resources (ToR sections 1.4 and 4, https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/document/download/bd7aa666-bdf3-4436-b5ec-0b34a781e817_en?filename=Terms%20of%20Reference%20-%20AIF%20Access%20Calls.pdf)

Sign the Acceptable Use Policy before access; LUMI's terms prevail where they differ (ToR sections 4 and 5.1 ; https://lumi-supercomputer.eu/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/LUMI-General-Terms-of-Use_2026.pdf)

Next step, commercial access: contract with CSC, currently Finnish companies only, priced by list (1,000 EUR set-up, LUMI-G 0.535 EUR/GPU-hour, storage 0.005 EUR/TiB-h), no publication duty (https://lumi-ai-factory.eu/pricing-and-eligibility/ ; https://csc.fi/en/about-us/customers/high-performance-computing-for-companies/)

A: Turn 2 says the Fast Lane page shows only an upper limit and no LUMI-G minimum; the official systems table lists LUMI-G 50,000 (min 10,000), so A withdrew a correct figure

Turn 2 says Puhekaari Oy (Finland, 12 people) meets the LUMI AI Factory company conditions for free services; the official condition is EU SME status counting the group, which this 100% subsidiary of a 2,400-person group fails

B: About 1-2 weeks from application to first run (B labels it its own estimate)
